text:
The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Tulsi Lal Amatya, chosen by the municipal council. The team note's alternative, Bishweshwar Prasad Koirala, doesn't match the record: he later became prime minister but was not Kathmandu's mayor. I'm still working from memory without a live source, so checking a list of Kathmandu mayors would confirm this.

CONFIDENCE: 80
